praising.label: Praising
praising.when: to highlight what particularly impressed you

phrases.t: By far the best aspect of … was …
The thing I loved most was …
One thing I would praise about … is that …
It was impossible not to admire …
If I had to single out one highlight, it would be …

tasks.question: What was the best thing about your last holiday?

cues.cue: sunset views / be / absolutely breathtaking
models: By far the best aspect of the trip was the sunset views, which were absolutely breathtaking every single evening.

cues.cue: local guide / share / fascinating stories
models: What made the tour so enjoyable was how the local guide shared fascinating stories, especially since he clearly loved his subject.

cues.cue: beaches / stay / remarkably clean and quiet
models: I was particularly impressed by how clean and quiet the beaches stayed, particularly the way local authorities kept them well maintained.

cues.cue: hotel service / go / above and beyond
models: The hotel service exceeded all my expectations, since the staff went above and beyond, which meant every request was handled instantly.

cues.cue: food / capture / the local culture perfectly
models: The thing I loved most was how the food captured the local culture perfectly, because every meal felt like a new discovery.

cues.cue: island / feel / untouched and peaceful
models: The main highlight of the trip was how untouched and peaceful the island felt, especially when compared to busier destinations.

tasks.question: What would you praise about a restaurant that impressed you?

cues.cue: chef / create / a genuinely inventive menu
models: One thing I would praise about the restaurant is that the chef created a genuinely inventive menu, which meant every dish felt like a surprise.

cues.cue: staff / remember / our previous order
models: I was particularly impressed by how the staff remembered our previous order, particularly the way it made us feel like regulars.

cues.cue: presentation / be / a real strength
models: A real strength of the restaurant was the presentation of every dish, and this made the whole meal feel special.

cues.cue: atmosphere / suit / both special occasions and casual dinners
models: If I had to single out one highlight, it would be the atmosphere, since it suited both special occasions and casual dinners equally well.

cues.cue: wine pairing / complement / the food beautifully
models: It was impossible not to admire how well the wine pairing complemented the food, which added to the overall sense of care in every course.

cues.cue: value for money / feel / genuinely excellent
models: The main highlight of the meal was the value for money, which felt genuinely excellent given the quality of every course.

tasks.question: What made a course or class you took particularly good?

cues.cue: lecturer / explain / complex ideas with real clarity
models: I was particularly impressed by how the lecturer explained complex ideas with real clarity, particularly the way she used everyday examples.

cues.cue: course / balance / theory and practical work well
models: A real strength of the course was how well it balanced theory and practical work, and this made the learning feel genuinely useful.

cues.cue: feedback / arrive / promptly and in detail
models: One thing I would praise about the course is that feedback arrived promptly and in detail, which meant we always knew how to improve.

cues.cue: class discussions / stay / lively and engaging
models: What made the classes so enjoyable was how lively and engaging the discussions stayed, especially since everyone felt comfortable contributing.

cues.cue: online resources / prove / genuinely helpful
models: The online resources exceeded all my expectations, since they proved genuinely helpful, which meant revision felt far less stressful.

cues.cue: tutor / stay / patient with every question
models: The thing I loved most was how patient the tutor stayed with every question, because nothing ever felt too basic to ask.

tasks.question: What did you love about a product you bought?

cues.cue: product / work / flawlessly from day one
models: The product exceeded all my expectations, since it worked flawlessly from day one, which meant I never once needed support.

cues.cue: design / feel / sleek and thoughtfully made
models: I was particularly impressed by the design, particularly the way it felt sleek and thoughtfully made in every detail.

cues.cue: battery life / last / far longer than advertised
models: A real strength of the product was the battery life, and this made it last far longer than advertised.

cues.cue: customer support / respond / within minutes
models: The thing I loved most was how customer support responded within minutes, because I never once felt left waiting.

cues.cue: packaging / feel / surprisingly eco-friendly
models: One thing I would praise about the brand is that the packaging feels surprisingly eco-friendly, which meant I felt good about the purchase.

cues.cue: app / update / regularly with useful features
models: If I had to single out one highlight, it would be the app, since it updates regularly with genuinely useful features.

tasks.question: What impressed you about a hotel you stayed in?

cues.cue: staff / greet / us warmly from the moment we arrived
models: I was particularly impressed by how warmly the staff greeted us from the moment we arrived, particularly the way they remembered our names throughout the stay.

cues.cue: rooms / feel / spotless and beautifully designed
models: By far the best aspect of the hotel was how spotless and beautifully designed the rooms were, which made every evening feel like a treat.

cues.cue: breakfast / offer / an impressive range of local dishes
models: What made breakfast so enjoyable was the impressive range of local dishes on offer, especially since everything was freshly made.

cues.cue: location / suit / both sightseeing and relaxing perfectly
models: The main highlight of the hotel was its location, especially when it suited both sightseeing and relaxing so perfectly.

cues.cue: spa / provide / a genuinely relaxing experience
models: It was impossible not to admire the spa, which added to an already relaxing stay.

cues.cue: concierge / go / out of their way to help
models: The thing I loved most was how the concierge went out of their way to help, because every recommendation felt personal and thoughtful.

tasks.question: What did you love about a film or book you experienced recently?

cues.cue: storyline / keep / me hooked from start to finish
models: What made the book so enjoyable was how the storyline kept me hooked from start to finish, especially since every chapter ended on a twist.

cues.cue: characters / feel / deeply believable
models: I was particularly impressed by the characters, particularly the way they felt deeply believable throughout the story.

cues.cue: cinematography / stand out / as a real strength
models: A real strength of the film was the cinematography, and this made every scene feel genuinely cinematic.

cues.cue: ending / tie / every thread together perfectly
models: The thing I loved most was how the ending tied every thread together perfectly, because nothing felt left unresolved.

cues.cue: soundtrack / add / real emotional depth
models: It was impossible not to admire the soundtrack, which added real emotional depth to every key scene.

cues.cue: dialogue / feel / sharp and natural throughout
models: One thing I would praise about the film is that the dialogue felt sharp and natural throughout, which meant every scene rang true.
